description: Fetch one record in the standard search/fetch connector format: the device or manufacturer behind a search id (device:<slug> or manufacturer:<slug>) as Markdown text, with its url and metadata (retrieval date, reuse terms). Use when the client works only with the standard search and fetch pair (ChatGPT connectors and deep research). Do not use when get_device or get_manufacturer is available: they return structured fields and a detail level. Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

id.description: A result id from search: device:<slug> or manufacturer:<slug>. A device or manufacturer page URL is accepted too. e.g. device:heartstart-frx-defibrillator-p180028

name: fetch
title: Fetch a record (ChatGPT format)
